caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular area bordered by a scalloped edge, all filled with a light brown or tan color. Inside the rectangle, a symmetrical floral or botanical motif extends from the center towards the left and right. The central shape is composed of three rounded, cloud-like forms stacked vertically, with smaller curved branches and leaves extending outward from the middle. At the top center, there is a round, grayish shape with cut-out patterns, resembling a flower or medallion, slightly darker than the surrounding tan background. The overall composition is flat, with the botanical elements rendered in slightly lighter and darker shades of brown, creating a subtle relief effect against the main background. The entire design is enclosed within a thin, pale outer border.
title: Chest
